title: Minimal models and Mori fibre spaces for generalized log canonical Q-pairs
summary: We resolve the existence form of the minimal-model conjecture for projective generalized log canonical ℚ-pairs over algebraically closed fields of characteristic zero. Such a pair admits a minimal model when its adjoint divisor is pseudo-effective, and a Mori fibre space otherwise, while keeping the nef ℚ-Cartier b-divisor fixed. Taking the nef part to be zero gives the corresponding result for ordinary log canonical ℚ-pairs.
family_title: Numerical semiampleness and generalized minimal models

review.reason: Establishes existence of minimal models or Mori fibre spaces for generalized log canonical pairs.
